verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer guide has a first-party section titled 'Introduction to event notifications and subscriptions' (/guide/notifications), so it does document a programmatic event-subscription capability. The pack never says the delivery mechanism is registrable outbound HTTP webhooks, as opposed to another push transport. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of webhook (HTTP callback) delivery, details on registering and managing subscriptions, supported event types, payload and verification details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
